06 Terms & Conditions of Wholesale Supply (Summary)
  1. Orders & Acceptance: All supply orders placed via phone, WhatsApp (+44 7984 709478), email, or Rootwills Direct online portal are subject to acceptance by Rootwills Ltd. Deliveries under £120.00 Net incur a standard £15.00 delivery surcharge.
  2. Temperature & Cold-Chain Integrity: Goods are transported under HACCP-compliant dual-temperature regimes (0–4°C for chilled dairy, -18°C for frozen). Risk in products transfers to Customer upon delivery at the store pass or unattended keyhole drop.
  3. Claims, Shortages & Rejections: Any damage, temperature break, or discrepancy must be reported in writing with photographic evidence within 24 hours of delivery to sales@rootwills.co.uk. Qualified claims result in an immediate credit note issued against the account.
  4. Settlement & Late Interest: Payment must be made strictly according to agreed credit terms. Overdue balances shall accrue statutory interest under the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998 at 8% above Bank of England base rate, plus statutory compensation fees.
  5. Retention of Title: Legal and beneficial ownership of all delivered goods remains with Rootwills Ltd until payment in full has been cleared into Rootwills Ltd's nominated bank account.
